doc.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The Brotherhood Crusade honor
summary: She describes her recent honor from the Brotherhood Crusade.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: Do you want to go back to any of the organizations, the Whitney Young award from the Urban League?

Oh my goodness. There are a lot of awards, all right? But I will tell you one thing. Just recently, I was honored by The Brotherhood Crusade. The Brotherhood Crusade, I have been with and known since they started, and I did one of the first fundraisers that they ever had. They gave me – they had an evening honoring Nancy Wilson a few weeks ago that was the most magnificent thing I’ve ever seen. Of all the honors and awards and dinners and all that, this one was absolutely magnificent. The pictures, when you walked in the hotel lobby, on the table. Nancy Wilson was everywhere. The invitation was something I’ve never seen. It was gorgeous. The Brotherhood Crusade is a wonderful – Danny Bakewell is a wonderful young man. Well, he’s younger than me. That’s why I say young man. But I’ve always – I was very much involved when the Crusade started, and they know they can call on me for whatever.
